text:
48세 남성 환자, acute pancreatitis로 입원. 원인: alcohol use.  
BP 110/70 mmHg, HR 98 bpm, RR 22 bpm, BT 37.8°C.  
SpO2 95% on room air.  
Abdominal pain severe 호소함.  
Morphine 4 mg IV PRN 투여함.  
NPO status 유지함.  
NG tube 적용함.  
Negative fluid balance 확인됨.  
환자 alert 상태 유지함.  
Gastroenterology team notify함.
